Courage, Kindness and Respect
Welcome to Curzon CE Combined School
Set in a stunning rural location but close to both Amersham and Wycombe, we are one of the best kept secrets in Buckinghamshire!
Curzon is a smaller than average school with small classes where your child is truly known. Our caring and experienced team encourage and nurture each pupil’s talents. At Curzon, we grow the whole child.
When entering our school, you will immediately feel the warmth, friendliness and passion that underpins all we do.
We promote excellent academic standards and a strong work ethic alongside the Christian values of courage, kindness and respect. Behaviour is excellent and we are proud of our inclusive school where everyone feels safe and valued.
Christian Vision and Associated Values
Growing the Whole Child
Our school vision is that every child and adult flourishes and grows like the mustard seed to become a tree to protect and support others. Throughout the school we provide opportunities for all our pupils to develop as confident and resilient learners who seek to help others. Our vision is underpinned by 3 core values: courage, kindness and respect.
